description.narrative: The program aims to increase social cohesion, reduce personal distress, and strengthen civic engagement in conflict-affected communities in Yemen. At the individual level, participants will gain emotional resilience, leadership skills, and tools for peaceful conflict resolution. Youth, women, and veterans will be empowered to contribute meaningfully to their communities. At the civil society level, trained local facilitators and community leaders will sustain psycho-social support and peacebuilding efforts beyond the program period. Community dialogues and civic engagement trainings will foster inclusive participation and local problem-solving. At the institutional level, local authorities and traditional leaders will be engaged in dialogue and capacity-building, promoting trust and collaboration. The program aim to build a network of trained individuals and community structures capable of continuing development and peacebuilding independently.
